2608.27011.title: Magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator
2608.27011.paper_summary: High-frequency artificial phononic crystals offer a low-loss platform compatible with on-chip integration, yet realizing Chern phononic phases at GHz frequencies remains challenging. Here, we propose a magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator in a honeycomb phononic crystal hybridized with ferromagnetic islands at the hexagon centers. A circularly polarized Kittel mode couples to the surrounding phonons with a phase winding, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and opens a full Chern gap. In the large-detuning regime, this mechanism leads to an effective Haldane-type phononic model with magnon-induced complex hopping. By tuning the magnon-phonon interaction, the full hybrid system accesses Chern phases with tunable Chern numbers |C|=1 and |C|=2. The predicted gaps can exceed realistic phonon and magnon linewidths, enabling their observation in GHz acoustic devices. Our work establishes chiral magnon--phonon hybridization as a route to magnetically reconfigurable topological phononics.
2608.27011.paper_summary_zh: 高頻人工聲子晶體提供了一個與片上集成兼容的低損耗平台，但在GHz頻率下實現Chern聲子相仍然具有挑戰性。在這裡，我們提出了一種在六角形中心與鐵磁島雜化的蜂窩聲子晶體中，由自旋波引起的聲子Chern絕緣體。一種圓偏振的Kittel模式與周圍的聲子耦合，並具有相位纏繞，這打破了時間反演對稱性並開啟了一個完整的Chern能隙。在大失諧範圍內，這一機制導致了一個有效的Haldane類型聲子模型，具有自旋波引起的複雜跳躍。通過調節自旋波-聲子相互作用，整個雜化系統可以訪問可調的Chern數的Chern相，|C|=1和|C|=2。預測的能隙可以超過現實的聲子和自旋波線寬，從而使其在GHz聲學設備中觀察成為可能。我們的工作確立了手性自旋波-聲子雜化作為磁性可重構拓撲聲子學的一條途徑。
